about_the_game:
Meet Alisha!

Meet Alisha — a bold, charismatic adventurer who holds nothing sacred! Even when she's breaking ground in the harsh Wasteland, she's ready to have fun and seduce. Her leopard-print swimsuit has long since slipped off her enormous chest, and her luscious ass vibrates with every recoil... Just a little longer, and not only will the workers' cocks be standing at attention — so will the entire production line!


Alisha always makes noise. If this hot piece ends up in your bed, the whole neighborhood will know exactly where and how many times you fucked. And it's not about being shameless, Alisha is just an honest girl with nothing to hide. To any moral guardians, she'd reply without batting an eye that envy is an ugly look!


WHAT YOU'RE GETTING?

By purchasing this DLC, you unlock Alisha in her shameless worker outfit. You can change your mascot at any time by opening your profile in-game and selecting the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
